# API reference of the engine, generated by Doxygen from the public headers.
#
#   cmake --preset dev -DBATTLESHIP_BUILD_DOCS=ON && cmake --build --preset dev --target docs
#
# The pages are written to docs/api/html.

find_package(Doxygen REQUIRED)

set(DOXYGEN_PROJECT_NAME "Battleship")
set(DOXYGEN_PROJECT_NUMBER "${PROJECT_VERSION}")
set(DOXYGEN_PROJECT_BRIEF "Game engine API")
set(DOXYGEN_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/docs/api")
set(DOXYGEN_OPTIMIZE_OUTPUT_FOR_C YES)
set(DOXYGEN_EXTRACT_STATIC YES)
set(DOXYGEN_GENERATE_LATEX NO)
set(DOXYGEN_QUIET YES)
set(DOXYGEN_WARN_IF_UNDOCUMENTED YES)
set(DOXYGEN_STRIP_FROM_PATH "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/include" "${PROJECT_BINARY_DIR}/generated")
set(DOXYGEN_STRIP_FROM_INC_PATH ${DOXYGEN_STRIP_FROM_PATH})

doxygen_add_docs(
  docs "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/include/battleship"
  "${PROJECT_BINARY_DIR}/generated/battleship/version.h"
  COMMENT "Generating the API reference with Doxygen")
